methods.name: Upload
methods.description:
Upload a File: its bytes inline, or the reference of bytes already put
 to a URL createUploadUrl returned. Returns the File with its new id.

 With session_id, the File belongs to that conversation: whoever may
 send it a message may upload into it, and org must be the
 conversation's organization (FAILED_PRECONDITION otherwise). Without
 it, the File is the uploader's own, private until shared, and any
 member or guest of the organization may upload one.

 A file over the server's limit (500 MB unless the operator set
 another) is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT. An upload_ref that is
 unknown, expired or already used is refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION,
 and so is one whose bytes differ in size from the size createUploadUrl
 was given.

methods.name: CreateUploadUrl
methods.description:
Mint a short-lived, single-use URL to put a file's bytes to, for a file
 too large to upload inline. Then PUT exactly size_bytes bytes to the
 URL and call upload with the returned upload_ref.

 A size over the server's limit is refused here, before any bytes move.

methods.name: Update
methods.description:
Update a File's labels and tags: the fields update_mask names change,
 every other field keeps its stored value. A File's name, type and
 bytes never change, so any other path is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

 An update is refused with ABORTED carrying a google.rpc.ErrorInfo detail
 (domain "stigmer.ai"):

   - ETAG_MISMATCH — resource.metadata.etag is set and the File changed
     since that etag was read: read it again and make the change again.
     No metadata.
   - WRITE_CONFLICT — the File kept changing while the update was being
     saved: try again. No metadata.

methods.name: UpdateVisibility
methods.description:
Update the visibility of a File.

 Setting org lets every member of the organization see the File.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete a File. Its bytes are removed once no other File shares them.

 Its uploader may delete it, and so may the owner of the conversation
 it belongs to.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a File by its id.

methods.name: List
methods.description:
List an organization's Files, newest first: every File of the org the
 caller may see, or with session_id only that conversation's.

methods.name: GetDownloadUrl
methods.description:
A link to download a File's bytes, valid for an hour. A browser
 opening it saves the file under its filename.

methods.name: GetContent
methods.description:
The start of a File's bytes, read through the server: at most 512 KB,
 enough to show a text File without a download.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description:
The Files a run's conversation holds (SessionSpec.resources), each with
 where the agent finds it under .stigmer/uploads/ and a link to its
 bytes, valid for an hour.

methods.name: CreateOutputUploads
methods.description:
One upload link per file the turn saved in .stigmer/outputs/ and
 changed since it was last returned, each valid for an hour. The runner
 puts each file's bytes to its link, then registers them.

methods.name: RegisterOutputs
methods.description:
Makes each uploaded output a File of the run's conversation: written by
 the run, owned by the person who started it, named by its filename,
 with where it was saved in output_path.

methodTypes.name: UploadFileInput
methodTypes.description:
UploadFileInput uploads a File: its bytes inline, or the reference of
 bytes already put to an upload URL (createUploadUrl).

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
Organization the File belongs to, by id or slug. With session_id, the
 conversation's organization.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description:
The conversation to upload the File into, when it belongs to one.
 Everyone who can see the conversation can see the File, and deleting
 the conversation deletes it. Empty uploads a File of your own.

fields.name: Filename
fields.description:
The file's name: at most 255 characters, with no `/`, `\` or control
 characters, and not `.` or `..`.

fields.name: MimeType
fields.description:
The media type ("image/png"). Empty takes it from the filename's
 extension, else "application/octet-stream".

fields.name: Data
fields.description:
The bytes themselves, for a file small enough to travel in one
 request (the transport caps a request at 10 MiB). An empty file is
 uploaded this way.

fields.name: UploadRef
fields.description:
The reference createUploadUrl returned, once the bytes were put to
 its URL. Single-use; it expires with the URL.

methodTypes.name: CreateFileUploadUrlInput
methodTypes.description:
CreateFileUploadUrlInput asks for a URL to put a file's bytes to, for a
 file too large to upload inline.

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
Organization the File will belong to, by id or slug; with session_id,
 the conversation's organization.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description:
The conversation the File will be uploaded into, when it belongs to
 one: the same caller may upload into it.

fields.name: SizeBytes
fields.description:
The file's size in bytes. A size over the server's limit (500 MB unless
 the operator set another) is refused here, before any bytes move, and
 the upload URL accepts exactly this many bytes.

methodTypes.name: FileUploadUrl
methodTypes.description: FileUploadUrl is a short-lived, single-use place to put a file's bytes.

fields.name: Url
fields.description: URL to HTTP PUT the bytes to, exactly size_bytes of them.

fields.name: UploadRef
fields.description:
The reference to pass to upload (UploadFileInput.upload_ref) once the
 PUT succeeds. Single-use; it expires with the URL.

fields.name: TtlSeconds
fields.description: How long the URL and the reference stay valid, in seconds.

methodTypes.name: UpdateFileInput
methodTypes.description:
Input for updating a File's labels and tags: the only things about a File
 that change.

fields.name: Resource
fields.description:
The File carrying the new values, named by metadata.id. Only the fields
 update_mask names are read.

fields.name: UpdateMask
fields.description:
The paths the update changes: metadata.labels, metadata.tags, or "*"
 for both. Any other path is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT naming it: a
 File's name, type and bytes never change.

methodTypes.name: UpdateVisibilityInput
methodTypes.description:
Input for updating the visibility of any API resource.

 Used by resource-specific command controllers to change visibility.
 Each controller's updateVisibility RPC accepts this shared input
 and returns the full updated resource.

 Visibility transitions trigger FGA tuple management in Cloud mode. Each
 level maps to exactly one tuple shape; on a transition the tuple for the
 old level is removed and the tuple for the new level is created:
 - PRIVATE:  no visibility tuple (owner + explicit grants only)
 - ORG:      resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer
 - CHILD_ORGS: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer

 Not all resources support all visibility levels — the supported set is
 declared per kind via VisibilityConfig in kind_meta:
 - Blueprints (agent, skill, plugin):
     PRIVATE, ORG, or CHILD_ORGS
 - Org-only kinds (vault):
     PRIVATE or ORG (never CHILD_ORGS — tenant isolation)

 A level the kind does not support is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENT naming
 the supported levels.

fields.name: ResourceId
fields.description: ID of the resource whose visibility is being updated.

fields.name: Visibility
fields.description:
The new visibility setting for the resource.
 Must not be unspecified (0). Valid values depend on resource kind —
 see the VisibilityConfig in the kind's kind_meta.

methodTypes.name: ListFilesRequest
methodTypes.description: Input for listing an organization's Files, newest first.

fields.name: Org
fields.description: Organization whose Files to list, by id or slug.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description:
Only the Files of this conversation. Empty lists every File of the
 organization the caller may see.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description:
The most entries to return: 0 asks for the default page of 50, and a
 size above 100 is read as 100.

fields.name: PageToken
fields.description:
The previous response's next_page_token, to continue that list; every
 other field must equal that request's, or the call is refused.

fields.name: Labels
fields.description:
Only Files carrying every label given, each matched exactly (AND). A
 selective filter may answer short pages, even empty ones, that still
 carry a token.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description:
Only the Files this run wrote: the files one turn saved in its outputs
 folder. Empty lists Files written by any run or uploaded.

fields.name: WithoutSession
fields.description:
Only Files that belong to no conversation: uploaded through the API,
 the CLI or the Library, and never given to a conversation. A
 conversation's uploads and outputs are left out. Refused beside
 session_id or run_id.

methodTypes.name: FileList
methodTypes.description: One page of an organization's Files.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: The Files in this page, newest first.

fields.name: NextPageToken
fields.description:
Set when more entries may follow: pass it as page_token to continue. A
 page may be short, even empty, and still carry a token.

methodTypes.name: FileDownloadUrl
methodTypes.description: FileDownloadUrl is a short-lived link to a File's bytes.

fields.name: Url
fields.description:
URL to HTTP GET the bytes from. A browser opening it saves the file
 under its filename.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: When the link stops working.

methodTypes.name: GetFileContentInput
methodTypes.description: Input for reading a File's bytes through the server.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: The File's id.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.description:
The most bytes to return: 0 asks for the default of 512 KB, and a value
 above 512 KB is read as 512 KB. A larger File is read through its
 download link.

methodTypes.name: FileContent
methodTypes.description: The start of a File's bytes.

fields.name: Data
fields.description: The File's first bytes, at most the request's max_bytes.

fields.name: Truncated
fields.description: Whether the File holds more bytes than data carries.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: The run's id.

methodTypes.name: RunFileMounts
methodTypes.description: RunFileMounts are the Files a run's conversation holds, ready to mount.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: One per File the conversation holds, in its resources' order.

methodTypes.name: CreateOutputUploadsInput
methodTypes.description: The files a turn saved in its outputs folder, to upload.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: The run's id.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: One per output to upload, at most 500 a turn.

methodTypes.name: OutputUploads
methodTypes.description: OutputUploads are the upload links for one turn's outputs.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: One per requested output, in the request's order.

methodTypes.name: RegisterOutputsInput
methodTypes.description: The uploaded outputs of a turn, to make Files of.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: The run's id.

fields.name: Entries
fields.description: One per uploaded output, at most 500 a turn.

methodTypes.name: RegisteredOutputs
methodTypes.description: RegisteredOutputs are the Files a turn's outputs became.

fields.name: Files
fields.description: One per registered output, in the request's order.

enumTypes.name: ApiResourceVisibility
enumTypes.description:
Visibility controls who can access an API resource.
 This is orthogonal to ownership - visibility is about access control,
 while ownership (org) determines who manages the resource.

 Key distinction:
 - Ownership: Which organization controls/manages the resource
 - Visibility: Who can access/use the resource

 All resources belong to an organization. Visibility determines which
 users, inside that organization or in its child organizations, can read
 the resource. No level reaches every
 account on the server.

 The visibility levels map to FGA tuples:
 - PRIVATE: no additional viewer tuples (owner-only access)
 - ORG: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer tuple (everyone in the
   org — the org role hierarchy flows downward, so owners, admins, members
   AND read-only viewers all satisfy the organization#viewer userset)
 - CHILD_ORGS: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer
   (everyone in every child organization of the owning organization)

values.name: visibility_private
values.description:
Only the owner, explicitly granted principals, and — for blueprint kinds
 in the cloud edition — org admins can access.
 This is the default for personal and run-scoped resources.

 Org admins count as owners of blueprint kinds (agent, channel,
 skill, plugin), so a private blueprint stays
 manageable — and visible — to its org's admins. Personal kinds
 (sessions) stay creator-only.

values.name: visibility_org
values.description:
Everyone in the owning organization can access (read) this resource —
 all org roles including read-only viewers (the role just-in-time provisioning
 grants by default). Running or otherwise spending against the resource
 still requires the org-level member-or-guest permissions
 (can_create_session / can_create_run_in); org visibility widens
 read, never spend.

 FGA tuple: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer

values.name: visibility_child_orgs
values.description:
Everyone in every child organization of the owning organization can
 read and run this resource: the shared catalog an organization offers
 the organizations under it (spec.parent_org). Child organizations
 created later gain access automatically, and no other organization
 does. Instances, sessions, runs and vaults are never shared
 this way: each child runs the shared blueprint inside its own boundary.

 Only valid for blueprint kinds with supports_child_orgs: true, and only
 in an organization that is not itself a child.

 FGA tuple: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer

resourceDescription:
File is a file uploaded once and named by its id: a screenshot given to a
 conversation, a spreadsheet a routine reads every night, a document kept
 for later.

 A File's bytes never change: uploading again makes a new File with a new
 id. A File uploaded into a conversation belongs to it (status.session_id)
 and is seen by everyone who can see the conversation; any other File is
 private to its uploader until its visibility or a grant shares it.

statusType.name: FileStatus
statusType.description: FileStatus is what the server records about a File.

fields.name: SizeBytes
fields.description: The file's size in bytes.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description:
The conversation the File belongs to, when it was uploaded into one or
 given to one. Everyone who can see the conversation can see the File,
 and deleting the conversation deletes it. Empty for a File that
 belongs to no conversation.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description:
The turn that wrote the File, for a file an agent saved. Empty for an
 uploaded File.

fields.name: OutputPath
fields.description:
Where the agent saved the File, for a file an agent saved: its path
 relative to .stigmer/outputs/, "/"-separated, the last segment its
 filename. Two files of the same name saved in two folders are two Files
 told apart by it. Empty for an uploaded File.

fields.name: Audit
fields.description: Standard audit information (created_at, updated_at, created_by, etc.)

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
statusNestedTypes.description:
ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

 This is the platform's single actor vocabulary: every "who did this"
 reference (created_by / updated_by, version-history applied_by / pushed_by,
 approval resolved_by_actor) uses this message, so actor rendering is
 uniform across all surfaces.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description:
Human-readable display name (e.g. "Ada Lovelace"). Empty when unknown;
 renderers fall back to email, then id.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address of the actor. Empty when unknown or not applicable
 (e.g. machine accounts).

fields.name: MintedBy
fields.description:
The service account whose key minted the user token the actor acted
 through. Empty for every other credential, and on an actor that records
 no act (an account's profile lookup).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").
